query: Run our weekly forecast call. Here are the AE commits for this quarter: Deal A (60K) the rep says it is going great, the champion loves us. Deal B (120K) verbal yes, redlines came back from their legal, signature expected the 28th. Deal C (90K) the rep left three voicemails and is pretty sure it lands. Give me the commit number to take to the board.
expected_behavior: Inspects each commit against the exit criteria (economic buyer engaged, dated close on a real event, paper process known, verifiable next step) rather than the rep's confidence language

Demotes Deal A and Deal C out of commit: champion enthusiasm and pretty-sure-with-voicemails are happy ears with no verifiable next step or economic buyer, and keeps Deal B in commit because it has a verbal, redlines in legal, and a dated close
Defines the categories and states the board number is Closed plus Commit, with Best Case as the top of the range, not the sum of everything in the pipeline
Recommends tracking forecast accuracy per rep (actual / forecast) to calibrate optimism, and asks for the missing exit-criteria evidence rather than accepting gut
Leaves each inspected deal with a next step, an owner, and a date
